say:1:1012123001:0.text: The corruption is bad here... This is more foul than the corrupted roots.
say:1:1012123001:0.source_cn: 腐化好严重……这肮脏的气息，比腐化根茎更甚。

say:5:1012123004:1.text: I'd be happy to. However, the river may be contaminated. It's best not to eat fish from this river just yet.
say:5:1012123004:1.source_cn: 我很乐意。不过……既然河水可能被污染了，最好也别食用河...

say:6:1012123005:1.source_cn: 时机不太凑巧。下次有机会，一定让你尝尝。

say:9:1012123008:0.text: Even I didn't know Eironn was good at cooking.
say:9:1012123008:0.source_cn: 连我都不知道埃隆擅长这些。
say:9:1012123008:0.male: Even I didn't know Eironn was good at cooking.
say:9:1012123008:0.female: Even I didn't know Eironn was good at cooking.

say:10:1012123009:0.text: I'm not good at cooking. It's just a little bit of survival skills.
say:10:1012123009:0.source_cn: 不擅长，只是稍微懂些生存技巧。
say:10:1012123009:0.male: I'm not good at cooking. It's just a little bit of survival skills.
say:10:1012123009:0.female: I'm not good at cooking. It's just a little bit of survival skills.

say:11:1012123010:1.text: I usually practice my swordplay in the deep mountains, so I cook enough to satisfy my needs.
say:11:1012123010:1.source_cn: 因为平日里在深山修行，吃不上精致的食物，只能勉强果腹。
say:11:1012123010:1.male: I usually practice my swordplay in the deep mountains, so I cook enough to satisfy my needs.
say:11:1012123010:1.female: I usually practice my swordplay in the deep mountains, so I cook enough to satisfy my needs.

say:12:1012123011:1.text: And that is how I gradually figured out how to make food go down easier.
say:12:1012123011:1.source_cn: 迫于那种条件，我逐渐摸索出了诀窍，能够让食物变得容易下咽。
say:12:1012123011:1.male: And that is how I gradually figured out how to make food go down easier.
say:12:1012123011:1.female: And that is how I gradually figured out how to make food go down easier.

say:14:1012123012:0.text: What a surprise! I thought Mister Eironn wouldn't be picky about food, but now I feel a little closer to you.
say:14:1012123012:0.source_cn: 真意外，我还以为埃隆先生不会挑剔食物呢？不过，这样的埃...

say:15:1012123013:0.text: What do you mean, Miss Hammie?
say:15:1012123013:0.source_cn: 这是什么意思？漫漫小姐。

say:16:1012123014:0.text: Because you're always looking off into the distance. Even now, I feel like the distance between us is vast... like the stars in the sky.
say:16:1012123014:0.source_cn: 因为埃隆先生总是看着远方，就算是现在，我也会觉得，你离...

say:18:1012123016:0.text: Right? After arriving at Taran Village, Eironn grew even more depressed, and that made me nervous for some reason. However, he was just able to relax a little.
say:18:1012123016:0.source_cn: 对吧？到了塔兰村以后，埃隆先生更加愁眉苦脸，搞得我很紧...

say:19:1012123017:0.text: What's bothering you, Eironn? With Magister Merlin here, you have nothing to fear!
say:19:1012123017:0.source_cn: 你到底在烦恼什么？有梅林在，根本不用担心！
say:19:1012123017:0.male: What's bothering you, Eironn? With Magister Merlin here, you have nothing to fear!
say:19:1012123017:0.female: What's bothering you, Eironn? With Magister Merlin here, you have nothing to fear!

say:20:1012123018:0.text: Yes, he is powerful. However, I can't always rely on others.
say:20:1012123018:0.source_cn: 你的主人很强大，可我不能总是依靠别人。
say:20:1012123018:0.male: Yes, he is powerful. However, I can't always rely on others.
say:20:1012123018:0.female: Yes, she is powerful. However, I can't always rely on others.

say:21:1012123019:0.text: Dare I ask, have you ever relied on anyone?

say:22:1012123020:0.text: If you have never relied on anyone, you are unfit to respond.
say:22:1012123020:0.source_cn: 既然从未依靠过别人，便没资格说这番话。

say:24:1012123022:1.text: Take your time, Eironn, and ponder my words with a thoughtful heart.
say:24:1012123022:1.source_cn: 有空时，认真想想我的话吧，埃隆。

say:25:1012123023:1.text: Let us share the cause of the ailment with the villagers for now. Lyca and the rest are waiting.
say:25:1012123023:1.source_cn: 现在，先将村民失常的原因告知他们，莱卡他们还在等待。

say:27:1012123006:1.text: You're too kind. I'm actually not very good at it. When it comes to cooking, it's Lorsan who's better.
say:27:1012123006:1.source_cn: 过奖了，我这点水平谈不上精通。论厨艺，还是洛桑更在行。
say:27:1012123006:1.male: You're too kind. I'm actually not very good at it. When it comes to cooking, it's Lorsan who's better.
say:27:1012123006:1.female: You're too kind. I'm actually not very good at it. When it comes to cooking, it's Lorsan who's better.

say:28:1012123007:1.text: However, if you'd like, I'll make sure to let you try my grilled fish sometime in the future.
say:28:1012123007:1.source_cn: 不过，要是你愿意，以后有机会，一定让你尝尝我烤的鱼。
